name: Photo Drop
desc: Guests scan a code and drop photos onto a shared desk. You approve each one first.
about: Run a live photo wall at a party: guests scan a QR code and send photos from their phones, you approve each one, and they land on a big screen like prints thrown on a desk.

proxy.$comment: plain HTTP only: party guests’ phones don’t trust the home certificate

intents.phrase: …let guests share photos on a big screen at a party
intents.desc: Guests scan a code and send photos; you approve each one and it lands on the TV like a print thrown on a desk.
